description: This file defines a French localization dictionary for a chat application, including translations for UI labels, messages, prompts, and dynamic functions for generating localized strings.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Generates placeholder hints for input based on the submit key, including instructions for sending messages and inserting line breaks.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Formats the version string for display.

methods.name: IsLatest
methods.description: Indicates whether the current version is the latest.

methods.name: CheckUpdate
methods.description: Initiates a check for software updates.

methods.name: FoundUpdate
methods.description: Formats a string indicating the availability of a new version.

methods.name: GoToUpdate
methods.description: Provides a link or action to update the software.

methods.name: Usage.SubTitle
methods.description: Displays the current account usage and total quota.

methods.name: Prompt.History
methods.description: Creates a summary string for the conversation history.

methods.name: Prompt.Topic
methods.description: Generates a prompt for summarizing the conversation topic.

methods.name: Prompt.Summarize
methods.description: Creates a prompt for summarizing past conversations.
